question: How many leaves is the employee entitled to?
answer:
- Leave type: Annual leave | Days per year: 20 working days | Key rules: Apply at least 7 days in advance for 3 or more days. [C1] Up to 10 unused days carry forward to the next year. [C1]

- Leave type: Sick leave | Days per year: 10 working days | Key rules: Inform your manager before 10:00 on the first day. [C2] A doctor's note is required for more than 3 consecutive days. [C2] Does not carry forward. [C2]

- Leave type: Casual leave | Days per year: 6 working days | Key rules: For short personal needs. [C3] At most 2 days at a time. [C3] Does not carry forward. [C3]

- Leave type: Maternity leave | Days per year: 26 weeks | Key rules: As provided by law. [C4] Apply at least 8 weeks before the expected date. [C4]

- Leave type: Paternity leave | Days per year: 10 working days | Key rules: To be taken within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption. [C5]

- Leave type: Bereavement leave | Days per year: 3 working days | Key rules: On the death of an immediate family member. [C6]

- This policy applies to all permanent employees of SwiftPay in India. [C7] Contractors and interns follow the terms in their contracts. [C7]

- The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. [C8] Leave is credited on 1 April for the full year; employees who join during the year receive leave in proportion to the months remaining. [C8]

question: How many days can employees work from home?
answer: - Employees may work from home up to 2 days a week with their manager's approval. [C1] On-call engineers may work from home during their on-call week. [C1] Work from home is not leave and is not recorded as leave. [C1]
